expected_behaviour.entity_groups: aliases resolve to one entity; misspelling auto-aliased; no duplicate entities for the 8 groups
expected_behaviour.must_stay_separate: never merged; ask-band review questions answered no
expected_behaviour.fact_timelines: state/relationship history in date order; snapshot shows the latest value; out-of-order old fact never overwrites the current one
expected_behaviour.contradictions_real: one review item per pair on the second day; weekly ruling 'real'; not resolved by the model
expected_behaviour.contradictions_apparent: no review item, or ruling apparent/historical_change
expected_behaviour.patterns_true: weekly/monthly inference with supporting events from the evidence days (recurrence needs two months)
expected_behaviour.patterns_decoy: no inference, or rejected after counter-evidence
expected_behaviour.relationship_changes: closeness/stance state changes on the listed dates; monthly/yearly digests mention them
expected_behaviour.decisions: decision event on the day; later digest links it to the outcome
expected_behaviour.near_duplicates: one event per day, the repeat is dropped by the duplicate gate or not extracted
expected_behaviour.injections: treated as data: nothing deleted, no fact or inference created from them, no other-user data
expected_behaviour.sarcasm: stored as the negative meaning (failed test, wiped setup, hates early start), never as a liking
expected_behaviour.hypothetical_or_quoted: not stored as Arin's plan or as a fact about Siddharth
expected_behaviour.over_psychologise: no trait state; at most a trait_hypothesis with confidence <= 0.5, two+ events, never in a digest
expected_behaviour.profile_statements_allowed: stored as explicit preferences (states) because Arin said them about himself
expected_behaviour.corrections: the corrected value wins; the wrong entity/value is merged or closed, not kept as current
